Definition: from the alternate of G2064; an advent:--coming.
BiblicalUsage: éleusis means a coming, an advent. It appears in Acts, and each time it carries that same plain sense.
TheologicalSignificance: For me, éleusis means a coming, an advent, nothing more and nothing less.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
